title: Blue Raz Candy by Chubby Juice E-Liquid | 100ml Short Fill
description:
Blue Raz Candy Shortfill E-Liquid:
Relive the nostalgia of your favourite childhood sweets with Blue Raz Candy. This flavour bursts with the tangy delight of sour blue raspberry, perfectly complemented by a sugary candy finish that’s irresistibly moreish. Reminiscent of classic Bon-Bons, it strikes a flawless balance between fruity tartness and sweet indulgence, making it a treat for anyone with a love for bold, candy-inspired flavours.
Product Features
Brand:
Chubby Juice
Brand Origin:
UK
Product Type:
Shortfill E-Liquid.
Bottle Size:
Supplied in a 120ml bottle containing 100ml of flavoured E-Liquid, leaving space for Nicotine shots if required, e.g., add 2 x 18mg Nicotine shots (not included) to 100ml to make a 3mg final strength.
Nicotine Type:
Nicotine Free.
Nicotine Strength:
This E-Liquid is 0mg (before any Nicotine
shots have been added – Tap here for our nic shot calculator.)
Juice Mix:
With a 70% VG / 30% PG mix, this E-Liquid is perfect for the Direct Inhale style of vaping using Sub Ohm Coils. Not recommended for MTL vaping.
